question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**Conscious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Conscious"** means being aware of and responding to one's surroundings; awake. (सचेत)
 
 
• **Example:** She was conscious of the fact that everyone was staring at her.
 
 
 
• **"Unaware"** refers to not being aware of something; not knowing or realizing. (अनजान)
 
 
• **Example:** He was unaware of the changes in the schedule.
